event_image.alt: Nikk Wise outside Harley’s Pub & Perk

events.title: Harley's Pub and Perk - Charcuterie
events.description:
Nikk Wise (nee Schmalz) is a born & raised Mildmay Resident, wife to Ryan, mother of 3 awesome daughters and finally you may know her best as the proud owner of Harley’s Pub & Perk for over 20 years.

She started her career off as a nurse but decided to switch it up & began working at the old Coffee Perk (which was located directly behind Harley’s!).

She was presented an opportunity to purchase the business in 1999. She ran that successfully until she was presented with another big opportunity to purchase the Commercial Hotel in 2004. It was a large undertaking but anyone who knows Nikk, knows she does not back down from a challenge.

The Commercial Hotel was built in 1872 & has been owned by many Schmalz’s throughout the years starting in 1919. It was operated under many names including The Commercial Hotel, Schmalz Country Inn, Cornerstone Inn and finally in 2004 it became Harley’s Pub & Perk (named after Nikk’s Uncle Harley who ran the hotel with her Grandpa Chucks for many years).

Since 2004, Nikk has expanded her business from a bar, to a beloved Pub, Coffee Shop & Catering Business.

Her passion for Mildmay, Bruce County & local businesses is on the forefront of all she does and she truly loves serving her community, one meal at a time.

“When you support a small business, you are supporting a dream”
